The '''Gultanna system''' was located in the [[Vadigult sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Luuq system/Legends|Luuq]] and [[Manoe system/Legends|Manoe systems]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] of the [[Luuq sector/Legends|same]] [[Manoe sector/Legends|name]], as well as the [[Barenth system/Legends|Barenth system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Gultanna system lay within territory controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gultanna system was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square K-8.<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', noted on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] of [[TheForce.net]] that Gultanna was created for "bookkeeping purposes" so that every sector listed in the Online Companion would have at least one corresponding system.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191013233754/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.}}</ref>
